propositions: Record a durable ADR (0100) documenting the lazy CLI route and capability architecture approved by the maintainer, replacing repeated CLI censuses with shared route/capability authority and normalizing help for 21 commands.

Implement a stdlib-only immutable top-level route registry with lazy handler and parser-factory module:function references, using side-effect-free argparse factories as the single authoritative grammar source for both runtime parsing and generated help.

Define deterministic, committed runtime-authoritative package help generation with grouped overview, pre-operation routing for help/alias/unknown before RP-04 snapshot/config/mount boundaries, and an explicit semantic capability registry with error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures.
Update docs/architecture.md to describe the implemented CLI boundary and link ADR 0100, and regenerate docs/adr/README.md and docs/adr/.numbers/0100 without hand-editing generated artifacts.

Resolve all research critique items (unverified assumptions, dependencies, unanswered questions, conflicts with ADR 0098) before drafting, run draft critique, and obtain explicit maintainer approval of the exact ADR draft through Gerrit HOLD before any implementation child starts.
